text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto desperately chases after T.M. 
Opera O day after day. However, around 
that time... a new star is born at the 
Hanshin Racecourse.

Admire Vega. A cool, taciturn Umamusume. 
Her running was undeniably worthy of the 
Classic spotlight.

One day, in the hallway of Tracen Academy, 
Meisho Doto accidentally collides head-on 
with Admire Vega, but—

Admire Vega didn't budge an inch. Feeling 
the immense strength in her legs, Meisho 
Doto realized what true top-tier prowess 
was.
